verdict.rationale: Org-wide admin policy enforcement is a fair question for an authenticator or password-manager product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only individual, anonymous, registration-free use with user-chosen security tiers, encryption and storage. Nothing shows an admin console, team management, or centrally enforced app-lock, export-restriction or master-password policies.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
